rationale: DEO gapped up 2.57% on modest positive news (a Zacks blog mention, not a fundamental catalyst), and price is now drifting lower from the open high of $91.16, sitting at 26.9% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing a steady decline. The stock is trading below both VWAP ($90.53) and the 9-EMA ($90.56), suggesting short-term selling pressure, but the gap fill thesis is risky given elevated relative volume (2.33x) that could indicate institutional accumulation supporting the gap. With no clear directional conviction and the price compressed near the low of the session range without a defined support level to anchor a stop, the risk/reward is insufficient to justify entry in either direction.
